g.text: Tolonen MED4 calibration: rank percentile per gene

Sole-N experiments = steady-state exponential growth on the sole N source vs N-replete Pro99 medium; N deprivation = 24 h of nitrogen deprivation vs N-replete Pro99 medium (KG control / treatment fields).

Source: analysis/data/de_long.csv.gz (cal_tolonen_cyanate, cal_tolonen_urea, cal_tolonen_ndep 24h); data/explore/e6b_calibration_bars.csv. ● / ▼ significant up / down (stored); dashed 0.5, dotted 0.9.
